title.zh-CN: 口渴背景下突然意识不清与抽搐
title.en: Sudden unconsciousness and convulsions after persistent thirst

summary.zh-CN: 已有血糖异常的成人突然出现意识障碍，水分平衡与后续尿量变化需要按时间线重新核对。
summary.en: An adult with known hyperglycaemia develops altered consciousness, requiring reassessment of water balance and subsequent urine output.

provenance.citation: 林鹭平, 罗芳涛, 沈小燕, 曾锦辉, 张劼. 高渗性非酮症糖尿病昏迷伴空泡蝶鞍尿崩症一例. 中华糖尿病杂志. 2010;02(02):154-154. doi: 10.3760/cma.j.issn.1674-5809.2010.02.017.

notes.zh-CN: 源自已发表单例报告。临床时间改为相对时间；姓名为化名；医院及身份细节去除。对话、阶段、问题与评分是教学设计。
notes.en: Based on one published case. Times are relative, names are pseudonyms, and hospital/identifying details are removed. Dialogue, phases, questions and scoring are educational design.

guidelines: 2024 adult hyperglycaemic-crises consensus and Society for Endocrinology inpatient cranial DI guidance 2018, checked 2026-10-28; scope monitored volume/sodium/glucose care and avoiding rapid sodium correction.

notes.zh-CN: 人工智能辅助初稿；尚未经独立编辑或执业医师审核。当前指南及来源DOI核验状态见导师指南。

disclaimer.zh-CN: 历史病例教学回看；原文处置不是个人治疗建议。未记录的生理反应不作模拟。
disclaimer.en: Historical case review for education; reported care is not individual treatment advice. Undocumented physiological responses are not simulated.

text.zh-CN: 血糖33.7 mmol/L，钠172、钾3.2 mmol/L，肌酐122.9 μmol/L，pH7.4、碳酸氢根36.5 mmol/L，尿酮阴性、比重1.005；头CT无异常。原文尿糖阴性与高血糖不相称；渗透压“392”的原文单位需复核。
text.en: Glucose 33.7 mmol/L, sodium 172 and potassium 3.2 mmol/L, creatinine 122.9 μmol/L, pH 7.4 and bicarbonate 36.5 mmol/L; negative urine ketones and specific gravity 1.005; head CT was unremarkable. Reported negative urine glucose conflicts with hyperglycaemia; the unit attached to reported osmolality “392” needs verification.

name.zh-CN: 血糖改善后的尿量与垂体记录
name.en: Urine output and pituitary records after glucose improvement

zh-CN: 血糖改善后的尿量与垂体记录
en: Urine output and pituitary records after glucose improvement

text.zh-CN: 治疗后恢复意识。约十天后血糖已控制，钠再升至162 mmol/L、尿量8.4 L/日。追问得知十八年多饮，每日5–8 L。既往完成的禁水/垂体后叶素试验中尿比重由1.005升至1.020、尿量减少；MRI示空蝶鞍。此为历史检查记录，不安排再次禁水。
text.en: Consciousness recovered after treatment. Around ten days later glucose was controlled but sodium rose again to 162 mmol/L with urine output 8.4 L/day. Further history disclosed eighteen years of drinking 5–8 L/day. A historically completed deprivation/posterior-pituitary extract test showed urine specific gravity rising from 1.005 to 1.020 with reduced output; MRI showed an empty sella. This is an old report, not an instruction to repeat deprivation.

source.zh-CN: 据原报告病例资料整理；对话为去标识化教学改写。
source.en: Adapted from the source case record; dialogue is a de-identified educational paraphrase.

text.zh-CN: 原文首日约补液9 L、尿量4.7 L，次日钠139 mmol/L；此下降速度不作为现行推荐。后用去氨加压素尿量降至1.4–2.4 L/日，但出现头晕及钠122 mmol/L；调低剂量后钠135 mmol/L，血糖5.5–7.4 mmol/L。长期结局未给出。
text.en: The source reported about 9 L fluid and 4.7 L urine on day one, with sodium 139 mmol/L the next day; this correction speed is not recommended practice. Desmopressin later reduced urine to 1.4–2.4 L/day but caused dizziness with sodium 122 mmol/L; dose reduction was followed by sodium 135 mmol/L and glucose 5.5–7.4 mmol/L. Long-term outcomes were not supplied.

prompt.zh-CN: 初始代谢资料最支持什么危急框架？
prompt.en: Which emergency framework best fits the initial metabolic findings?

need.zh-CN: 先调阅当前阶段的检查记录，再比较不同解释。
need.en: Review the current investigation records before comparing explanations.

text.zh-CN: 高血糖与严重高钠相关高渗状态，需同时调查自由水丢失
text.en: A hyperosmolar state with hyperglycaemia and severe hypernatraemia, also requiring investigation of water loss

feedback.zh-CN: 缺乏酮症酸中毒证据，稀尿不能被忽略。
feedback.en: Ketoacidosis is unsupported, and dilute urine must not be ignored.

text.zh-CN: 只要昏迷和高糖就是酮症酸中毒
text.en: Coma with hyperglycaemia necessarily means ketoacidosis

feedback.zh-CN: pH、碳酸氢根和尿酮不支持该结论。
feedback.en: The pH, bicarbonate and urine ketones do not support it.

text.zh-CN: 头CT正常便可忽略钠和血糖
text.en: Normal head CT allows sodium and glucose to be ignored

feedback.zh-CN: 严重代谢异常本身可危及神经功能。
feedback.en: Severe metabolic disturbance can itself threaten neurological function.

prompt.zh-CN: 后续资料能支持哪一项结论？
prompt.en: Which conclusion is supported by the subsequent records?

need.zh-CN: 先核对后续验证资料，再评估它能和不能说明什么。
need.en: Review the subsequent records before judging what they do and do not establish.

text.zh-CN: 控制血糖后持续稀尿高钠、激素反应支持中枢性水调节缺陷；空蝶鞍是相关线索
text.en: Persistent dilute polyuria and hypernatraemia after glucose control, with hormone responsiveness, support central water-regulation deficiency; empty sella is an associated clue

feedback.zh-CN: 不能把影像关联直接升级为唯一病因，完整垂体评估缺失。
feedback.en: Imaging association is not proof of a sole cause; full pituitary assessment is missing.

text.zh-CN: 血糖正常后仍可把所有尿量归因糖尿
text.en: All urine loss can still be attributed to glycosuria after glucose normalises

feedback.zh-CN: 尿量和血钠持续异常需要独立解释。
feedback.en: Persistent urine and sodium abnormalities need an independent explanation.

text.zh-CN: 空蝶鞍已证明所有垂体激素缺乏
text.en: Empty sella proves deficiency of every pituitary hormone

feedback.zh-CN: 结构影像不等同完整功能评估。
feedback.en: Structural imaging does not replace functional assessment.

prompt.zh-CN: 当前安全管理最需防止什么？
prompt.en: Which safety problem needs particular attention in current care?

need.zh-CN: 先形成工作判断，再核对后续证据和安全边界。
need.en: Form a working interpretation, then review subsequent evidence and safety limits.

text.zh-CN: 严密监测血钠、尿量、容量和血糖，协调补液与去氨加压素，避免纠正过快及低钠
text.en: Closely monitor sodium, urine output, volume and glucose, coordinating fluids with desmopressin to avoid rapid correction and hyponatraemia

feedback.zh-CN: 不能照搬旧文一天血钠由172降至139或固定补液量。
feedback.en: Do not copy the historical fall from 172 to 139 in one day or a fixed fluid volume.

text.zh-CN: 把原文第一天钠下降幅度作为目标
text.en: Use the source first-day sodium fall as the target

feedback.zh-CN: 历史变化不构成安全纠正目标。
feedback.en: A historical change is not a safe correction target.

text.zh-CN: 严重高钠时让患者自行禁水验证
text.en: Ask the patient to self-deprive water during severe hypernatraemia

feedback.zh-CN: 进一步限水可能加重危险失水。
feedback.en: Further water restriction can worsen dangerous water loss.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 说明严重高钠和稀尿要求同时评估水代谢。；承认缺少完整垂体功能、原始渗透压单位核验及长期结局；初始尿糖存在矛盾。，用复述确认理解。
judgeGuidance.en: Explain that Severe hypernatraemia with dilute urine requires assessment of water regulation.; acknowledge Complete pituitary testing, verified original osmolality units and long-term outcomes are absent; initial urine glucose is discordant. and check understanding through teach-back.

knowledge.zh-CN: 帮助比较已经调阅的证据，区分工作诊断、确证资料和未解决问题，不提前透露结局。
knowledge.en: Help compare evidence already reviewed, distinguish working diagnoses from corroboration and unresolved questions, and do not disclose outcomes early.

conclusion.zh-CN: 原报告为高渗高血糖状态合并中枢性尿崩症表现，MRI空蝶鞍；去氨加压素后低钠体现监测的重要性。
conclusion.en: The report describes hyperosmolar hyperglycaemia with central diabetes-insipidus physiology and an empty sella; subsequent desmopressin-associated hyponatraemia highlights monitoring.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 严重高钠和稀尿要求同时评估水代谢。
keyReasoning.en: Severe hypernatraemia with dilute urine requires assessment of water regulation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 血糖改善后异常仍在，排除单一糖尿解释。
keyReasoning.en: Persistent abnormalities after glucose improvement challenge a glycosuria-only explanation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 影像关联和历史治疗效果各有边界。
keyReasoning.en: Imaging associations and historical treatment responses have limits.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 纠正速度不能从单例结局倒推为安全。
teachingPoints.en: An apparently favourable outcome does not establish safe correction speed.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 抗利尿治疗和饮水补液需要协调。
teachingPoints.en: Antidiuresis and fluid intake require coordination.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 初诊不能口述者由明确教学角色提供记录。
teachingPoints.en: A non-speaking presentation uses an explicitly educational record-relaying role.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例报告不能证明疗法的普遍有效性；历史处置只用于复盘。当前安全选项是教学推理，不提供可自行执行的药物剂量。
boundaries.en: A single report cannot establish general treatment efficacy; historical care is reviewed as evidence. Safety options are educational reasoning without self-administered drug doses.

unknowns.zh-CN: 缺少完整垂体功能、原始渗透压单位核验及长期结局；初始尿糖存在矛盾。
unknowns.en: Complete pituitary testing, verified original osmolality units and long-term outcomes are absent; initial urine glucose is discordant.
